column2: *** The collection is DGS 8166573, images 72-478 *** - the same film as the informaciones matrimoniales, in a separate block. The ark this archive already held for Pedro Antonio's baptism, 3:1:3Q9M-CS2Z-WH52, resolves to *** dgs:008166573 image 274 ***.
column4: *** THE ARCHIVE HAD THE ARK AND NEVER RESOLVED IT. *** Having it meant the volume could have been walked at any point since the addressing trick was found this morning. *** It also disproved this session's own claim that the film held nothing below image 1057 *** - see the correction in data/informaciones-1791-walk.tsv.

column1: *** PEDRO ANTONIO'S BAPTISM, READ FROM THE IMAGE AT LAST ***
column2: *** 'En la Villa del Canelon a primero de Agosto de mil setecientos noventa y tres, el Capellan del Regimiento de Infanteria de Buenos Ayres Don Bartolome Munoz bautizo, puso oleo y crisma a PEDRO ANTONIO DE LA SS.ma TRINIDAD, que nacio ayer, hijo legitimo del Soldado Dragon Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez. Fueron padrinos Don ANTONIO ALEMAN y su mujer...' *** Margin: *** 'Pedro Antonio Llerena' ***.
column4: *** THE ARCHIVE HELD THIS ACT ONLY AS A FULL-TEXT TRANSCRIPT. *** Reading the image adds *** the full baptismal name - 'de la Santisima Trinidad' *** - and *** the godparents, Don Antonio Aleman and his wife ***, neither of which was here before. *** It confirms the birth date the register already carried: 'nacio ayer' on 1 August 1793 means 31 July 1793. ***

column1: *** A QUERY THAT FINDS THEIR CHILDREN DIRECTLY ***
column2: *** Full text for the phrase 'Llerena y de Maria Fernandez' returns six documents. *** Three are this family: *** Canelones Baptism Records 1794-1810 (dgs:008166571 image 1130) ***; *** Cordon, Montevideo, Religious Marriage Records 1825-1916 (dgs:007713391 image 1669) ***; and *** Montevideo Catedral Baptism Records 1825-1828, TWO images (dgs:007713376 images 515 and 601) ***. The other three are a Valladolid nobility file and two notarial records from the town of Llerena in Badajoz - *** the place, not the family. ***
column4: *** SEARCHING THE PARENTS AS A PAIR IS THE RIGHT INSTRUMENT AND IT IS CHEAP. *** The phrase only occurs when a document names both of them, which happens when a child is baptised, when a child marries, or *** when a GRANDCHILD is baptised and the grandparents are named. *** The two 1825-1828 cathedral images are almost certainly the third kind. *** THREE OF THE FIVE IMAGES ARE STILL UNREAD. ***

column1: *** JUSTA PASTORA'S MARRIAGE - ALREADY HELD, AND THE ARCHIVE WAS RIGHT ***
column2: *** 'Noviembre de 1830. Manuel Zeferino Barros con Justa Pastora Llerena. Casados y Velados. En tres de Noviembre... precedidas informaciones... hija legitima de Sancho Llerena y de Maria Fernandez.' ***
column4: *** NOTHING NEW EXCEPT AN IMAGE REFERENCE - AND A FOURTH MISREADING BY THIS SESSION. *** At fit-width the heading was read as *** 'Noviembre de 1836' *** and this archive's five records of *** 3 November 1830 *** briefly looked like a contradiction. *** At magnification the heading is plainly 1830. The archive was right and the session was wrong. *** That is now *** four fit-width misreadings in one day *** - Mendoza for Berroeta, Llerena for Juarez, Rosalia Illera for Petrona Illescas, and 1836 for 1830. *** None reached the site, because each was magnified before it was believed. The rule is holding; it is the habit of trusting a small image that is not. ***
